note: Same defect as D1 outside N-0101 scope: apps/api/app/query/cache.py _try_redis() does `from app.core.config import settings` inside `try/except Exception` (app.core.config only exports get_settings()), logged at DEBUG as 'Redis unavailable'. So the P3-2 query result cache has never used Redis; it is process-local only (API and worker caches not shared). Not changed here (write scope is site_pause.py and its tests). Fix shape is the same as N-0101 round 2: get_settings().redis_url, narrow the except to connection/timeout errors, warn once.
